articles.mainIdea: QXO Is Raising Another $1.8 Billion for Its M&A War Chest
articles.summary: Barrons.com: QXO Is Raising Another $1.8 Billion for Its M&A War Chest. Building-supplies company QXO could be moving closer to making another big acquisition. The firm, led by serial entrepreneur Brad Jacobs, announced Monday that it is raising an additional $1.8 billion in financing for possible takeover offers. Shares of QXO had been up 3% in early trading Monday. Related tickers mentioned: APO, APO-PA, QXO, RXEEY, RXLSF, URI, WM, XPO.
